title: Cute Blog Creator
description: A simple and bright blog webpage that allows users to create blog posts with titles, descriptions, and image uploads. Perfect for sharing thoughts and visuals in a fun and easy way.

features.name: Create Blog Post
features.description: Allows users to create a blog post by entering a title, description, and uploading an image.

features.name: Upload Images
features.description: Enables users to upload images to accompany their blog posts without restrictions on file size or format.

features.name: Bright and Cute Design
features.description: The webpage will feature a visually appealing, bright, and cute design to enhance user experience.

target_users: Individuals who want a simple platform to create and share blog posts with images.
data_requirements: Each blog post will store a title, description, and an associated image.
